# Vectors, Matrices & Operations

> Multiply things.

**Type:** Build
**Languages:** Python (stdlib)
**Prerequisites:** Phase 1, Lesson 01 (Linear Algebra Intuition)
**Time:** ~60 minutes

## Key Terms

| Term | What people say | What it actually means |
|------|-----------------|------------------------|
| Dot product | "Multiply and add" | Sum of elementwise products. |
| Softmax | "Turn scores into probabilities" | Exponentiate and normalise. |
